history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A black and white, moody, atmospheric photograph taken at night. Three custom motorcycles are parked in a paved lot, illuminated by a dramatic overhead spotlight that casts long shadows. The motorcycle in the foreground is a bobber-style bike with a wide, chunky front tire and a low-slung profile. To its right, a second motorcycle, also black, has a more classic cruiser aesthetic with spoked wheels and a prominent headlight. The third motorcycle, further back, is partially obscured but appears to be similar in style. A young person in a dark shirt and light-colored pants stands to the left of the foreground motorcycle, looking away from the camera, adding a human element to the scene. In the background, silhouetted trees with intricate branches are visible against the dark night sky, with a streetlamp casting a faint glow. The overall mood is one of quiet contemplation and urban cool, with the stark contrast of light and shadow creating a cinematic feel. The color palette is exclusively black, white, and shades of gray, enhancing the dramatic and gritty atmosphere.
